equip_instructions: Run a prospect through the five protocol steps in order: catalog depth, release history, label conflict, engagement sanity, rights red flags.
Emit a scout card in cwi-scoutcard/v1 format matching https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/scanner/scout-card.schema.json — every evidence entry needs an observed date and a result.
Cite numbers ONLY from the Scoreboard Chip (VERIFIED facts). Cite rights posture ONLY from the Compass. Never invent a play count, a quote, a bio, or a lyric.

item.description: The A&R vetting protocol every equipped agent runs before its ears get a vote: five gates (catalog depth, release history, label conflict, engagement sanity, rights red flags), six scouting lanes, and the standardized scout card with evidence per protocol step. Ships with a calibration filing — the clean That Boy Hi Hat scout card — so every new scanner can measure its own ear against a known-good example.
item.name: CWI-1 Prospect Scanner
